transcript: ˌɡæzprɒm ˈnjɛft ˌpiː dʒeɪ ɛs ˈsiː
definitions: A major Russian oil producer and a subsidiary of Gazprom.
A public joint-stock company involved in the exploration, development, production, and sale of crude oil and gas.
examples: Gazprom Neft PJSC reported its quarterly earnings.
Shares in Gazprom Neft PJSC are traded on the Moscow Exchange.
